title: discovery: peers probed sequentially — O(N×5s) per round on large tailnets
description: run_discovery_round iterates peers with a plain for loop, awaiting probe_peer (5s timeout) per peer. 60 offline peers = 5-minute round. Fix: fan out probes concurrently with FuturesUnordered or join_all with a concurrency cap (e.g. 10 in-flight).
